{{Top|leg}}
An '''oxygen sensor''' was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] that measured [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] levels. They were usually found in control stations monitoring interior environments, such as on the [[Imperial Aquatic Garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]].<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>

*''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''
